testSuite: SauceDemo Checkout Flow E2E Test Cases

testCases.title: Successful End-to-End Checkout Flow with a Single Item (Happy Path)
testCases.description: Verify that a logged-in user can complete a purchase with one item in the cart from selection to order confirmation.
preconditions: At least one item is added to the cart.

steps.action: Click on the Shopping Cart icon at the top right.
steps.expectedResult: User is navigated to '/cart.html' displaying 'Sauce Labs Backpack' with quantity 1.
User is navigated to '/checkout-step-one.html' (Your Information page).

steps.action: Enter First Name 'John', Last Name 'Doe', and Zip/Postal Code '12345'.
steps.expectedResult: Input fields are populated with the provided test data.

steps.action: Review payment info, shipping info, price total, and click 'Finish'.

testCases.expectedOutcome: Header displays 'Thank you for your order!' and shopping cart badge is cleared.

testCases.title: Successful End-to-End Checkout Flow with Multiple Items
testCases.description: Verify that a user can purchase multiple items simultaneously and order overview reflects all selected items.

steps.action: Add 'Sauce Labs Backpack', 'Sauce Labs Bike Light', and 'Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt' to the cart.
Click the Shopping Cart icon and click 'Checkout'.
Fill in First Name 'Jane', Last Name 'Smith', Zip '90210' and click 'Continue'.
Verify all 3 items appear in the Overview list with correct prices.
steps.expectedResult: All 3 items are displayed with correct individual prices.
Order is placed successfully with 'Thank you for your order!' page shown.

testCases.expectedOutcome: Order completed successfully with multiple items.

testCases.title: Checkout Step One Validation - Missing First Name
testCases.description: Verify validation error when First Name is left blank on the checkout information page.
preconditions: User has items in cart and is on '/checkout-step-one.html'.

steps.action: Enter 'Doe' in 'Last Name' and '12345' in 'Zip/Postal Code'.
steps.expectedResult: Last Name and Postal Code fields are populated.

testCases.expectedOutcome: Error text displays 'Error: First Name is required' and user stays on '/checkout-step-one.html'.

testCases.title: Checkout Step One Validation - Missing Last Name
testCases.description: Verify validation error when Last Name is left blank on the checkout information page.
preconditions: User has items in cart and is on '/checkout-step-one.html'.
testCases.expectedOutcome: Error text displays 'Error: Last Name is required' and user stays on '/checkout-step-one.html'.

testCases.title: Checkout Step One Validation - Missing Postal Code
testCases.description: Verify validation error when Zip/Postal Code is left blank on the checkout information page.
preconditions: User has items in cart and is on '/checkout-step-one.html'.

steps.action: Enter 'John' in 'First Name' and 'Doe' in 'Last Name'.
steps.expectedResult: First Name and Last Name fields are populated.

testCases.expectedOutcome: Error text displays 'Error: Postal Code is required' and user stays on '/checkout-step-one.html'.

testCases.title: Cancel Checkout from Information Page (Step One)
testCases.description: Verify clicking 'Cancel' on Checkout Step One redirects user back to the cart page.
preconditions: User has 1 item in cart and is on '/checkout-step-one.html'.

steps.action: Click the 'Cancel' button on the Checkout Step One form.

steps.expectedResult: The previously added item remains in the cart intact.

testCases.expectedOutcome: Checkout cancelled and cart contents preserved on '/cart.html'.

testCases.title: Cancel Checkout from Overview Page (Step Two)
testCases.description: Verify clicking 'Cancel' on Checkout Overview page returns user to Inventory page without completing order.
preconditions: User completed Step One and is currently on '/checkout-step-two.html'.

steps.action: Click the 'Cancel' button at the bottom of the overview page.

steps.expectedResult: Cart badge retains existing item count.

testCases.expectedOutcome: Order is not completed and user returns safely to product inventory page.

testCases.title: Verify Price Total, Tax, and Calculations on Overview Page
testCases.description: Verify item total, tax calculation (8%), and total price match sum of items in cart.
preconditions: User added Sauce Labs Backpack ($29.99) and Sauce Labs Bike Light ($9.99).

steps.action: Proceed through Checkout Step One to Checkout Overview page.

testCases.expectedOutcome: Item total, tax, and overall total calculations are accurate.

testCases.title: Attempt Checkout with Empty Cart
testCases.description: Verify system behavior when user navigates to cart with 0 items and attempts checkout.

steps.action: Click on the Shopping Cart icon.
steps.expectedResult: User is navigated to '/cart.html' displaying empty list.
User is either prevented from proceeding or redirected.

testCases.expectedOutcome: Checkout cannot be placed with empty cart.

testCases.title: Back Home Navigation Post Order Completion and Cart Reset
testCases.description: Verify clicking 'Back Home' on checkout complete page resets application state and clears cart.

steps.action: Verify completion message 'Thank you for your order!' is displayed.
steps.expectedResult: Completion message and pony dispatch text are visible.
Cart badge is removed / shows 0 items.

testCases.expectedOutcome: User is returned to inventory page and cart state is completely reset.
